findings.detail: The fair value currency is stored as non-USD (U_EUR/U_GBP) even though the source schedule presents the Fair Value column in dollars.

rationale: FX02 is a Class 1 row-level currency-unit check on fair_value_currency. The raw schedule of investments identifies the Fair Value column and displays dollar signs for the same cost/fair-value column group; rows such as Accel International and MRO Holdings continuation revolver rows inherit that USD fair-value column, and the Aerospace & Defense subtotal is also dollar-denominated. The stored fair_value_currency values U_EUR/U_GBP are therefore inconsistent with the raw source presentation, so the flag is a real currency-unit extraction/tagging error rather than a false alarm. No aggregate anchor was needed.
